racecards.race_name: McGrath Limestone Works Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: French hurdles winner took second after long absence latest; that could set him up nicely
runners.spotlight: Bought for 40,000euros after winning a French hurdle on very soft in October 2024; decent effort to take second at Wexford last month (2m, soft), given it came after a 519-day absence at 11-1; that could set him up nicely for this.

runners.comment: C&D m'den hurdle winner on this card last year; well beaten on h'cap debut when last seen
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; C&D maiden hurdle winner on this card last year (good); mixed hurdles and the Flat with no success since and was soundly beaten on handicap debut at Down Royal when last seen in November; dropped 2lb and Kennedy picks him over Miss Manzor, but others appeal more.

stable_tour.quote: He looked like he was coming to win at Cheltenham on Friday but probably didn't quite get home over that trip. We'll go back to two miles with him and he should be very competitive in some nice handicap hurdles. 26-10-25

runners.comment: Back-to-back hurdles winner in 2024; chance if ready but returns from a 319-day absence
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner had back-to-back successes over hurdles in 2024, in a C&D maiden hurdle (yielding to soft) and a Listed handicap at Listowel off 116 (2m, soft); unseen since finishing a 3l third at Listowel in June (2m, good); chance if ready, but it's a long layoff.

runners.comment: Novice hurdle winner may come on from his first run back at Cork earlier this month
runners.spotlight: Won a Killarney novice hurdle and second (beaten 7.5l) in a Down Royal handicap, both over 2m1f on yielding ground last autumn; may come on from his first run back at Cork earlier this month when weakened into tenth.

runners.comment: Flat/hurdles winner was poor in 2025 runs; best watched on stable debut
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; Flat/hurdles winner in France won over hurdles in 2024 for Willie Mullins and some good runs in defeat afterwards; moderate chase runs and was tailed off in a Curragh handicap when last seen in May; makes stable debut now and is stable second string.

quotes.race: Racing TV Club Day At Fairyhouse Hurdle
quotes.quote: Miss Manzor has a lovely attitude and she jumped brilliant, with the experience she had in France. She stays really well and was a simple ride - Paul Townend, jockey.

stable_tour.quote: She looks big enough to jump a fence but will probably stay over hurdles for the time being as she's only four. 25-11-24

prev_owners.owner: M J Smith/David L'Estrange/Oisin Mahon/Mrs M D O'Callaghan

runners.comment: Flat winner won on hurdling debut but has been poor in two other hurdle starts
runners.spotlight: Flat winner made an immediate impact sent hurdling when successful in a Navan maiden hurdle in March last year (2m, heavy); way below that in a Naas novice hurdle next time (2m, good to yielding); posted some decent efforts on the level over summer/autumn but tailed off in a Naas novice hurdle (6-4 favourite) when last seen (2m, soft to heavy); makes stable debut.

quotes.race: Meath Farm Machinery Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: He's done nothing wrong at home since we got him. Positive Energy went to Robbie Power's for three weeks just to teach him the basics. He had a run in a schooling bumper at Naas recently so that told us he might handle the ground but he's never been on anything this heavy. Sean (Flanagan) just said he made a couple of mistakes, he was a little in his hands as they went a sensible gallop but they needed to in order to get home. He might have a few runs on the Flat and then there might be a novice hurdle for him in Galway, we'll have a bit of craic - Michael O'Callaghan, trainer, speaking to Racing TV.

runners.comment: Back-to-back hurdles winner in 2024; reverts to timber after two moderate chase runs
runners.spotlight: Back-to-back novice handicap hurdle winner at Gowran (2m, yielding) and Punchestown (2m1f, soft) in 2024; struggled off revised mark in three subsequent runs; reverts to timber following two moderate efforts in beginners' chases; needs to come back to his best.

runners.comment: Galway specialist has been way below his best in runs since fourth at last year's festival
runners.spotlight: Galway specialist with four of his five Flat wins and both hurdle successes coming there; long way below his best in hurdle runs since fourth at his favourite track at last year's festival.

quotes.race: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Teed Up just seems to grow another leg when he meets the rising ground around here. They went a good gallop and Conor was good and cool on him. He'll get a little holiday now - Emmet Mullins, trainer.

quotes.race: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
quotes.quote: The trip was a slight concern but Ray gave Teed Up a fantastic ride. He slotted in and had the pace to travel, and he handled the ground, which is a great advantage today. It was a funny race as I think the early pace collapsed coming down into the dip, but he showed guts to tough it out on his own. He was a bit wayward but he kept his head down - Emmet Mullins, trainer.

quotes.race: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Teed Up is a horse that loves this track. He was a bit lairy in front but he loves that hill. He might mix it with the Flat - Emmet Mullins, trainer.

quotes.race: Kone Handicap
quotes.quote: He's a horse on the up the whole time. We were positioned in mid-division and he was on and off the bridle a little, he ran in snatches a bit but I think that was due to the ground more than anything. To be fair to him, when I picked him up in the dip he kept finding for pressure. He's won cosily, I put my whip down in the last 100yds and he was pulling up a little late on. The ground is very testing - Billy Lee, rider of Teed Up

runners.comment: No wins since 2023; back on song when second at Naas but weakened up in trip latest
runners.spotlight: Without a win since December 2023; back on song when a 1.25l second at Naas in February (2m, heavy) but weakened late when upped to 2m3f back there latest; seems best on very testing ground.

runners.comment: Last seen winning a m'den hurdle in Sept'; chance but this trip looks on the short side
runners.spotlight: Point and bumper winner left poor form over hurdles behind when runner-up on handicap debut at Galway off 105 after stepping up markedly in trip to 2m6f (good); built on that to win a Downpatrick maiden hurdle when last seen in September (2m2f, yielding); has run well after a break before, but this trip looks on the short side.

runners.owner: John T O'Connor & Michael P Gleeson
runners.comment: Added third hurdles win before SU at Wexford last time when fav'; in the mix
runners.spotlight: Added a third hurdle win at Naas in February off 110 (2m, heavy), beating Catch A Beast by 1.25l; raised 6lb but sent off the 100-30 favourite at Wexford last time and slipped up early in the race; mark could still be workable and he's in the mix.

runners.breeder: New England Stud & Mount Coote Stud
runners.comment: Three-time hurdles winner intersperses wins with moderate runs; chance if on a going day
runners.spotlight: Winner of a 2m2f maiden hurdle here last September (soft); moderate in two runs subsequently before springing a surprise at 40-1 in a Punchestown conditions hurdle (2m, heavy); more middling starts before winning off 113 in a Punchestown handicap in January (2m, heavy); well beaten in two February runs but a good runner-up finish off 1lb lower at Navan last time.

runners.comment: Maiden hurdle winner needs to settle better than he did at Gowran last time
runners.spotlight: Limerick maiden hurdle winner (2m, heavy) in November; has run well in a couple of handicaps, although too keen and didn't get home on latest at Gowran; needs to settle better; beaten over 15l when fourth of six at Limerick on Thursday.

runners.comment: Dual hurdles winner hasn't shown anything in four runs since returning from a long absence
runners.spotlight: Two-time winner over hurdles, including at Listed level, but hasn't shown anything in four runs since returning from a mammoth absence.

quotes.race: Pat Walsh Memorial Irish EBF Mares Hurdle (Listed Race)
quotes.quote: We said we'd try and steal a march on them - if you're not brave you're nothing in life. Robbie gave She Is Electric a super ride. We always knew she was a decent filly - she had a few little problems early on - but she's a valuable filly now, a proper little one. She's a handicapper to jump, she'd jump out of jail for you - Norman Lee, trainer

racecards.verdict: French hurdle winner BECASSE returned from a 519-day absence at Wexford when second and that could set him up nicely for this
racecards.betting_forecast: 4/1 Becasse, 5/1 High Court Cave, 11/2 Give Him A Chance, 7/1 Sopelana, 10/1 Frankendael,  Catch The Beast, 12/1 Arch Empire,  Positive Energy,  Piccolo Player, 14/1 Wholelotofbusiness, 16/1 Miss Manzor, 20/1 Sonny May, 33/1 Teed Up, 40/1 She Is Electric

racecards.race_name: BOYLE Sports Supporting Irish Racing Mares Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Below best over hurdles at Cork but in the mix back against her own sex and handles mud
runners.spotlight: Came good at Punchestown (16.5f, yielding) on New Year's Eve in her first handicap; second in valuable mares' handicap at the DRF; headed close home over fences at Leopardstown last month; below best over hurdles at Cork but in the mix back against her own sex and handles the mud.

quotes.race: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: The main thing was to get Dameauscottlestown jumping, she's only had three runs. She jumped brilliant and went through the race beautiful and put it to bed easy enough. I was always happy, we went a right gallop for the first mile. When they slowed up down the back, she travelled into it brilliant. She got a good jump at the last and put it to bed quick. Hopefully she can build on this - Gavin Cromwell, trainer.

runners.comment: Course winner; progressive chaser; 16lb lower hurdles mark on return but best form on good
runners.spotlight: Won 2m6f course handicap hurdle off 113 in September 2024 on good; big improver over fences in second half of 2025, an easy win at Tramore followed by clearcut handicap win at Roscommon; disappointed in Cheltenham Grade 2 in November (favourite); 16lb lower hurdles mark on return but best form on good.

quotes.race: Follow Us On Instagram Mares Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Cobra Queen was a bit unlucky when she fell the last day but jumped well today and travelled well. She did it nicely - Rachael Blackmore, rider.

stable_tour.quote: It looked like she ran a bit flat at Wincanton in the Rising Stars on Saturday. She got a bit outpaced and it just didn't happen for her. I'd say she'll definitely go on a break now, and we'll bring her back for the spring. 11-11-25

runners.comment: Ran well in Grade 3s of late; top claimer booked and dangerous if allowed a soft lead
runners.spotlight: Dual point winner; off the mark over hurdles in 2m4f Clonmel mares' maiden (yielding) in October; better form in novice events since, running with credit in pair of Grade 3s; top claimer booked back in a handicap and dangerous if allowed a soft lead.

quotes.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: Carry On Heidi ran well at Kilbeggan, but she got kicked below at the start and was knocked out for three weeks, so fair play to her. She is still short of work. We knew she would be in the first three. The further the better and if the ground is a bit softer, she loves it, so we are hopeful she can get better - Jeremiah Baragry, trainer.

runners.comment: Both wins at Fairyhouse, including on latest when perhaps lucky; up 7lb but can go well
runners.spotlight: Gained second win at Fairyhouse (2m4f, yielding to soft) 12 days ago, perhaps a fortuitous winner after being left clear when Royal Soldier fell at the last; raised 7lb for that but this is an ease in grade and she should go well.

quotes.race: Cawley Furniture Novice Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: She's been working very well for the last couple of weeks, so we were expecting a big run from Katie Daniels today. She wasn't finished with at the last, there was definitely more as she stays well. She won a point-to-point. She loves Fairyhouse, a flat track. Ben gave her a brilliant ride, he knows her well and I'm delighted for Ben as he's a massive part of our yard. She'll probably go to Punchestown. It was great to get that today on a big weekend - Cian Collins, trainer.

runners.comment: Returns from a year off the track for shrewd yard; Jack Kennedy booked; market will guide
runners.spotlight: Won a weak Punchestown maiden (2m7f, heavy) in February of last year; outclassed in Limerick Grade 3 next time; faded into midfield on handicap debut at Cork (24.5f); returns from a year off the track for shrewd yard; Jack Kennedy booked; market will guide.

quotes.race: 50,000 Euros BetVictor Graduation Bonus Series Mares Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: We knew stepping up in trip was going to suit Joshua's Daylami. We've done an awful lot of schooling down at Paddy and Jack Kennedy's, although Cian (Cullinan) said once she brushes up her jumping she'll be better again. There's the Shannon Spray Novice Hurdle (mares) in Limerick, we might just go there, or there's a novice handicap in Fairyhouse at Easter - Paul Fahey, trainer, speaking to Racing TV

runners.comment: Bred to get this trip and she's one to keep a close eye on in the market on handicap debut
runners.spotlight: Easy Naas bumper winner (soft to heavy) in November; posted two solid efforts in 2m mares' maidens of late; bred to get this trip and she's one to keep a close eye on in the market on her handicap debut.

runners.owner: Living Life to The Maxios Syndicate
runners.comment: Consistent; tackles this trip for the first time and yard won this race in 2022 and 2024
runners.spotlight: Solid form in handicaps; good DRF run when fourth of 18 behind the progressive Cousin Kate; hit the frame again in two subsequent starts; tackles this trip for the first time and yard won this race in 2022 and 2024.

runners.comment: Dual winner for Shane Crawley at around 3m but two poor runs after mammoth absence
runners.spotlight: Dual winner for Shane Crawley at around 3m; needed the run after a mammoth absence on debut for this yard at Navan last month; failed to build on that 10 days later when pulled up at Limerick.

quotes.race: Mallow Commercials CVRT Test Centre Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Ian was confident on Elsannah with a lap to go and gave her a peach of a ride. He had her exactly where she needed to be and she battled like a lion. With the ground likely to dry out, we might have to put her away. I won't take any chances - Shane Crawley, trainer.

runners.comment: Both wins at Sligo but runner-up four times around here, including this race in 2023
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come at Sligo but runner-up four times around here, including this race in 2023; fifth in last year's renewal; 3lb above last winning mark on return and would be of interest if the market speaks in her favour.

runners.comment: Sligo winner in 2024; inconsistent form over hurdles/fences since & ground is against her
runners.spotlight: Front-runner's sole win came in Sligo mares' maiden (2m2f, good) in June 2024; very inconsistent form over hurdles/fences since and ground is against her; 2lb wrong.

racecards.verdict: SHADYS LADY proved her liking for the mud when bolting up in a Naas bumper and could be lurking off a lenient mark on handicap debut

racecards.race_name: Sherry Fitzgerald Mayo Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Kilbeggan maiden winner; first run for new yard but testing ground is a concern
runners.spotlight: Sole win for Adrian Murray came in Kilbeggan maiden (2m4f, good) in June 2024; last seen under rules with good second at Sligo in August off 97; made no impact in three point-to-points end of last year; first run for Sam Curling; testing ground a concern.

runners.comment: In great form since returning from absence, winning easily at Limerick last time; player
runners.spotlight: Solid effort back from an absence at Down Royal when just denied; raised 4lb but won going away at Limerick (21.5f, soft) last month; up a further 7lb but must be respected in her current mood.

runners.comment: Kept on in closing stages at Limerick on handicap debut; could improve again up in trip
runners.spotlight: Showed very little in four maidens; slight improvement on handicap debut at Limerick (2m3f) in December, keeping on from rear to finish fifth of 13 without threatening; good claimer booked to ease the burden and the extra distance should help; player.

runners.comment: Won this race last year but hasn't been seen since; didn't enjoy this ground in the past
runners.spotlight: Finished off last season in good form, returning from a break to gain her third career win in this race (good) off 90; has had issues as hasn't been seen since and she didn't handle soft ground in the past.

runners.comment: Fine effort at Fairyhouse and better than the bare result at Limerick; cheekpieces now
runners.spotlight: Comes into the reckoning judged on his much-improved second at Fairyhouse (2m4f, heavy) on penultimate; was right there until three out before fading and pulling up at Limerick on latest; not discounted in first-time cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Best form at Kilbeggan with two wins; off the track since last June; market will guide
runners.spotlight: Dual Kilbeggan chase/hurdles winner since joining this yard, latterly off 80 over timber around this time last year (24.5f, yielding); beaten a neck at Tipperary next time off revised mark; fell at the fifth at Kilbeggan in June; market best guide returning from absence.

runners.comment: Last win at Fairyhouse in 2024; returns from an absence for new yard; can only be watched
runners.spotlight: Two career wins at around 3m, latterly at Fairyhouse off 90 in October 2024; never a factor in two runs last year; returns from an absence for new yard; can only be watched.

quotes.race: House Restaurant Open For All Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: We didn't go overly hard and Ranger Billy jumped very well. I could save him everywhere and to be fair to him he picked up well in the straight. He's not blessed with speed but stepping back up in trip helped and he's very genuine - Donagh Meyler, rider

runners.breeder: D & I Collins,A Burke & D Gavin
runners.comment: Hasn't shown a lot in maidens or handicaps and off the track 549 days; others preferred
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in three maidens; 13l behind and wandered under pressure on handicap debut at Roscommon; folded tamely at Punchestown; off the track 549 days; others preferred.

runners.comment: Poor form in bumpers and maidens; new headgear combination; handicap debut
runners.spotlight: Poor form in bumpers and made no impact in four maidens; new headgear combination; handicap debut but still difficult to warm to.

runners.comment: Ran well for a long way in Clonmel chase 15 days ago; front-runner could go well here
runners.spotlight: Sole win came over fences at Limerick in 2023 off 88 (3m, soft); caught the eye on first run back with this yard in Clonmel handicap chase 15 days ago, weakening late on after a forceful ride; entitled to go well in first-time cheekpieces.

quotes.race: Agritech Handicap Chase
quotes.quote: Made In The Woods is a grand horse at this grade. He is a lovely horse for soft ground and three miles. He might go back over hurdles now. There are more days in him but at his own grade - Norman Lee, trainer.

runners.comment: Has found the right level in handicaps, placed in three of her last four starts; player
runners.spotlight: Showed nothing in maidens; has found the right level in handicaps, placed in three of her last four starts; always in rear when pulled up at Fairyhouse in January but she's in the mix with a bounce back.

runners.owner: John Patrick Ryan & Miss Gillian Ryan
runners.comment: Definite promise when third at Clonmel (2m3f, soft) last time under a positive ride
runners.spotlight: Returned from a lengthy absence with three poor runs, but there was definite promise when third at Clonmel (2m3f, soft) last time under a positive ride; respected from the same mark.

runners.comment: Veteran 0-14 under rules and was pulled up over fences at Tramore; safe to look elsewhere
runners.spotlight: Veteran is 0-14 under rules and was pulled up over fences at Tramore on New Year's Day; safe to look elsewhere.

runners.breeder: M Goulven, Mlle Celine, M Pierre-Yves Berthouloux & Mme Fa
runners.owner: Profit In Your Pocket Racing Club
runners.comment: Won at Wexford last summer but hasn't shown a great deal of form since
runners.spotlight: Veteran showed he retains the ability to compete at a modest level when winning at Wexford last July (2m, good) but he hasn't looked like a winner in waiting since; others more likely.

runners.comment: 2-24 over fences; 0-22 over hurdles; chase campaign this season has yielding nothing
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; 2-24 over fences; 0-22 over hurdles; chase campaign this season has yielding nothing, pulled up on her last two outings; hard to make a case for her.

quotes.race: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Chase
quotes.quote: Eddies Pride needs to be ridden cold and to come late, Gary gave her a fantastic ride and did exactly as he was told. She's a lovely, well-bred mare that has had a lot of niggly problems. She'll stay at it - Norman Lee, trainer.

runners.comment: Galway win in September 2024 was a flash in the pan; unplaced in 32 of his 33 starts
runners.spotlight: Galway win in September 2024 was a flash in the pan; unplaced in 32 of his 33 starts; well beaten on return from a break at Thurles in January; can't fancy.

runners.comment: Six Flat wins in Britain and handles the mud; 6-1 for handicap hurdle debut but poor run
runners.spotlight: First reserve; six Flat wins in Britain (four on AW); successful on soft and heavy on turf; hinted at ability in three maiden hurdles; disappointed on handicap hurdle debut at Limerick but was strong in the market (sent off 6-1); better expected if he gets a run.

runners.comment: No show in maidens and has failed to complete in two of three handicap starts; reserve
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; no show in maidens and has failed to complete in two of three handicap starts; passed over.

runners.comment: Some promise in last maiden run at Punchestown but yet to figure in two handicaps; reserve
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; some promise in last maiden run at Punchestown but yet to figure in two handicaps.

racecards.verdict: Preference is for Eric McNamara's ILLTAKEHIMMYSELF, who has few miles on the clock and can improve on his handicap bow 5th at Limerick

racecards.race_name: Lodge At Ashford Castle Handicap Hurdle

runners.breeder: M David Bernier, Mme Anne-Sophie Bernier, Mme Charlotte Bern
runners.comment: Yard 2-5 at track last term and had 2 run really well at Aintree so worth a market check
runners.spotlight: Leopardstown handicap winner in March 2024 (3m, soft to heavy); luckless spell chasing of late, pulled up when last seen in Fairyhouse handicap in February; stable 2-5 at the track last season and had two runners run really well at Aintree, so worth a market check.

runners.comment: Easy Thurles win in January; fourth in Listed next time; pulled up latest but this easier
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner; 1-19 over hurdles with the victory off 100 in decisive fashion at Thurles (2m4f, heavy) in January; ran a nice fourth in Listed novice at Navan before pulled up in good Fairyhouse handicap 12 days ago; eased in grade.

quotes.race: Killinan Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Mi Lucky Cailin had finished second to some good mares in her maidens previously so she was entitled to win that. She loved the ground, and loves work and pleasing you. She's a joy to have. She's back in a good place now and Jack made things easier today. We have six or eight horses in training, it's not easy but days like today make it fun! - William McLernon, trainer.

quotes.race: Front Door 4-Y-O Fillies (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
quotes.quote: Mi Lucky Cailin is a smart mare and this wasn't really a surprise. She was very impressive in a schooling bumper at Tipperary ten days ago. She's tough, genuine and loves pleasing you - William McLernon, trainer.

runners.comment: Not much luck chasing; first run for Elliott; any market support could be significant
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner over 2m5f on good; best effort over fences when second in 2m5f Roscommon beginners' event last June but struggled in that sphere since; first run for Gordon Elliott; any market support could be significant.

runners.owner: John J McGrath & T C Quinn
runners.comment: Bolted up at Limerick but pulled up at Fairyhouse; front-runner should enjoy it here
runners.spotlight: Bolted up by 22l in 14-runner Limerick handicap (2m5f, heavy) in February off 94 but failed to back that up off revised mark when pulled up at Fairyhouse; front-runner should be suited to this course.

quotes.race: Munster Suite @ Limerick Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: It didn't feel like I was going to get caught. I was always holding on to loads and waiting for them to come to me, but they never did. Survivors Sister relished that ground too. It was great to get that win - it's been a while since I got on the scoresheet and I was plagued by a collarbone injury. All thanks to my physio John Butler and everyone else that has helped. - Jack Gilligan, jockey.

runners.comment: Gowran win on heavy; this trip will suit and every drop of rain will enhance his chance
runners.spotlight: Off the mark on second handicap attempt, coming home well to assert from the last at Gowran (2m4f, heavy) last month; couldn't get going on slightly better ground when seventh of 20 at Fairyhouse 12 days ago (6-1 favourite); step up in trip will suit and every drop of rain will enhance his chance.

quotes.race: Holden Fleet Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: We bought Sky And Sand from Jonathan and Mikey Fogarty after he went to point-to-points for them and they recommended him. He ran an absolute shocker on his first day this season that we were left dumbfounded in the ring afterwards but we put a line through it and he improved a hell of a lot the last day. He stepped forward again today and he handled the ground, which was the key. He's a fine, big strong horse, who will jump a fence as well hopefully. He's so big, we won't risk him on nicer ground but he'll go chasing in the autumn. - Ross O'Sullivan, trainer.

runners.comment: Chase winner bolted up over hurdles at Punchestown on heavy when last seen; 13lb higher
runners.spotlight: Only his second chase start when getting up close home at Roscommon (2m5f, yielding) last August; took advantage of lower hurdles mark in style at Punchestown (20.5f, heavy) in November; 13lb higher but respected after a break; Mark Walsh's sole ride on the card.

quotes.race: Kepak Handicap Chase
quotes.quote: He's been a little disappointing over hurdles so we thought a switch to fences might revitalise It's Never Simple. The fences slow the whole ting down and help him to stay, he finished it out well. If he hadn't missed the second-last he might won half a length. He hasn't been the easiest to train. I think he'll handle slower ground so there may be another one in him. He's relaxing more in his races now. - Martin Brassil, trainer, speaking to Racing TV

runners.comment: Modest form but best run came in 2m1f maiden on this card last year; handicap debut
runners.spotlight: Modest form but best run came in 2m1f maiden on this card last year; two poor efforts last summer, pulled up at Cartmel before outclassed in Galway novice; market will reveal expectations on handicap debut.

runners.comment: Galway maiden hurdle winner in 2023 on soft but poor form since returning from break
runners.spotlight: Galway maiden hurdle winner in 2023 on soft, beating the useful Olympic Man; has shown nothing (including chasing) since returning from more than two years off the track; player off this mark if ability remains, but leap of faith required; blinkers.

runners.breeder: E U R L Ecurie Audoy Christian
runners.comment: Latest run at Thurles easily forgiven as went clear early and over-exerted; in the mix
runners.spotlight: Sole win came back in 2022 (2m, good); lightly raced in recent seasons but hit the frame at Navan and Fairyhouse at around 2m4f this season; latest run at Thurles easily forgiven as went clear early and over-exerted; in the mix.

quotes.race: Leo Dolan Memorial Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Low Style was a shell of a horse last year. He came back in a lot stronger since the summer, and hopefully he can go on from there. He's more of a Summer horse - Barry Connell, owner-trainer.

runners.comment: Down Royal mares' maiden winner in April 2024 but has struggled since; first-time blinkers
runners.spotlight: Down Royal mares' maiden winner in April 2024 but has struggled since; first-time blinkers need to have an effect.

runners.comment: Shock 200-1 winner of Galway bumper in August 2024; completely out of form in 2025
runners.spotlight: Shock 200-1 winner of Galway bumper in August 2024; completely out of form in 2025; impossible to fancy on return.

runners.breeder: S C E A De La Vallee De L'Orne
runners.owner: Frederick Pardy & Thomas O'Hara & Peter Dawes & Crispin Wall

prev_owners.owner: Frederick Pardy/Thomas O'Hara/Peter Dawe/ P J Rothwell

runners.comment: Just the one win to his name but has run well in defeat a couple of times lately; chance
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 21 starts over hurdles was at Punchestown (2m4f, heavy) in February last year off 78; good effort when third at Fairyhouse on New Year's Day and not a bad effort at Naas (3m) last time; each-way possibilities.

runners.comment: Promising reappearance under this rider (on for all 7 wins) at Naas before lesser effort
runners.spotlight: Six-time winner in Britain; gained first Irish win at Clonmel (2m4f, heavy) in January 2024 on her third and final start for Marie Harding; at the veteran stage now but promising reappearance under this rider (aboard for all seven wins) at Naas before lesser effort at Clonmel.

quotes.race: Tipperary Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: I thought the 2m4f might be too short for Lissen To The Lady today, but it was heavier ground which suits her. I bought her to put in foal and while we'll see what happens, she will probably be covered this year - Joanna Walton, owner/rider.

runners.comment: Chance at his best but hold-up style of racing not sure to suit around here
runners.spotlight: Punchestown winner (2m4f, heavy) in February last year off 78; made the frame three times from five starts this season; chance at his best but hold-up style of racing not sure to suit around here.

quotes.race: Festival 2025 Group Tickets From 27 Euros Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
quotes.quote: My lad races lazily but when I started to get after Without Exception after the second-last he seemed to be picking up and picking up. Philip (Rothwell) said ride him wide and I did, it worked out anyway. The ground at Down Royal last time was too quick, these conditions suited - Tiernan Power Roche, jockey, speaking to Racing TV

racecards.verdict: The vote goes to SKY AND SAND, who relished heavy at Gowran last month and should have conditions in his favour here

runners.comment: 60,000euros 3yo; half-brother to Brentford Hope; stable 4-10 in bumpers this season
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; 60,000euros 3yo; half-brother to three winners including Brentford Hope (1m-1m2f Flat inc 2yo, RPR 109; useful 1m7f-2m1f hurdle); dam French 1m3f winner; stable 4-10 in bumpers this season; respected.

runners.comment: Dam out of bumper winning sister to Kicking King; stable 1-9 in bumpers this season
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Golden Sunrise (2m2f hurdle/3m chase) and Queens Present (point/2m4f hurdle), out of bumper-winning sister to Cheltenham Gold Cup/dual King George VI Chase winner Kicking King; stable 1-9 in bumpers this season.

runners.comment: Dam out of half-sister to two Champion Hurdle winners but best watched here
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; half-brother to bumper winner Major Robinson; unraced dam closely related to useful bumper/2m hurdle/2m4f chase winner Avoca Promise, out of half-sister to Champion Hurdle winners Morley Street and Granville Again; best watched.

runners.breeder: E A R L Ecurie Des Mottes
runners.comment: Good fourth on debut; the one to beat with some experience under his belt
runners.spotlight: Sent off 4-1 for his debut at Leopardstown (2m, soft to heavy) when beaten around 4l into fourth of eight; sets a good standard and likely to improve; the one to beat with the benefit of experience under his belt; stable 1-45 in bumpers.

runners.owner: Natalie Gilligan & Mark Watson & Brian J O'Higgins
runners.comment: Price reduced to 5,000euros at three; stable 0-33 in bumpers last five seasons
runners.spotlight: Price reduced to 5,000euros at three; dam unraced half-sister to three winners including Minella Awards (smart 2m4f-3m1f hurdle/chase); stable 0-33 in bumpers last five seasons.

runners.comment: First foal by Order Of St George; hooded on debut for top yard; shortlisted
runners.spotlight: First foal by Order Of St George; dam useful 2m2f-2m5f hurdle/chase winner, sister to 2m6f hurdle winner Deluxe Range, out of unraced half-sister to 2m hurdle winner Good Thyne Diva; hooded on debut for top yard; shortlisted.

runners.comment: Half-sister to 12.3f/12.5f Flat (RPR 68) and 2m hurdle winner Spanish John; watch
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to 12.3f/12.5f Flat (RPR 68) and 2m hurdle winner Spanish John; dam 1m1f Flat winner (76)/maiden hurdler, out of half-sister to Italian St Leger winner Spanish Hidalgo; stable 1-9 in bumpers this season; watch.

racecards.verdict: Terence O'Brien has sent out four winners from 10 bumper runners this season and his 60,000euros purchase BALLYADAM STAR should go well
